geometry.note: Building footprint only; the specific beamlines/experiments inside (H2/H4/H6/H8, ProtoDUNE-SP, ProtoDUNE-DP, NA64) are not separately located within it.

method: OpenStreetMap building footprint way 24265381 (building=university, name '887'), used verbatim. Building number 887 matches the identification already recorded in the EHN1 site record's own note ('also known as Building 887'). A web-search summary reported '55 m wide, 330 m long' for this building, but no primary page could be fetched to quote that figure (the two CERN pages found for it, the North Area EHN1 page and the CERN report on the North Area during Long Shutdown 2, both returned 404 on 2026-09-18), so no length check is asserted. The polygon's own measured maximum span is about 296 m, in the same range as that unconfirmed figure.
name: EHN1 / Building 887 (CERN Neutrino Platform hall)

summary.plain: The North Area test-beam hall (EHN1, Building 887) on CERN's Prévessin site, home to the CERN Neutrino Platform, ProtoDUNE-SP/DP and NA64.
